methods.name: bootstrap
methods.desc:
Create the coupon ASA, held entirely by this app. Creator only, once.
The app account must be funded first (base MBR + asset MBR + this inner fee).

methods.name: register
methods.desc: Register the sender as a PQ printer by revealing the preimage of its address.

args.name: pqKey
args.desc: salt (1 byte) followed by the Falcon-1024 public key (1793 bytes)

args.name: beneficiary
args.desc: account that receives the coupons on claim; must already be opted in to PQPRINT

args.name: mbrPay
args.desc: exactly PRINTER_BOX_MBR to this app, refunded on claim

methods.name: print
methods.desc: One coupon per call. The call itself is the PQ transaction being rewarded.

methods.name: claim
methods.desc:
Pay out all coupons to the beneficiary, delete the printer box and refund its MBR.
If the beneficiary has opted out since registering, the coupons are forfeited
(they stay with the app) so the deposit can never be locked. Returns coupons paid.
The caller covers the two inner transaction fees.

methods.name: pending
methods.desc: Read-only: coupons owed to a printer that has not claimed yet.
